articles.titleCn: 对NLP文本分类器中成员推理攻击的经验评估：基于SST-2的基线研究
articles.abstractCn: 成员推理攻击（MIAs）试图判断特定记录是否被用于训练模型，这在自然语言处理（NLP）中是一个隐私风险，因为训练数据可能包含敏感用户文本。本文在GLUE SST-2情感数据集上对文本分类的成员推理脆弱性进行了一项受控基准测试。在损失阈值MIA下，比较了TF-IDF + 逻辑回归流程和微调的DistilBERT分类器，效用通过开发准确率和宏观F1来衡量。DistilBERT达到了0.9466的准确率和0.9460的宏观F1，而逻辑回归为0.8756和0.8727，但两个模型都泄露了成员信号（攻击AUC分别为0.5615和0.5800）。测试了两种缓解措施。更强的正则化降低了逻辑回归的泄露，但以明显的效用成本为代价，而将DistilBERT微调2个epoch而不是3个epoch减少了泄露，且几乎没有准确率损失。轻量级的训练调整可以在无需复杂防御的情况下改善隐私-效用权衡。

articles.title: Using Semantic Uncertainty to Estimate Transition Relevance in Turn-taking
articles.abstract: Turn-taking is a fundamental mechanism that governs when interlocutors speak and listen. Although Spoken Dialogue Systems (SDS) exploit a range of linguistic, acoustic, and non-verbal cues, they produce ill-timed responses in unscripted interaction. A central challenge is anticipating Transition Relevance Places (TRPs), or opportunities, not obligations, for a listener to take the floor. Human listeners do not wait for turn endings; as an utterance unfolds, they use expectations about its developing meaning to anticipate TRPs and decide whether to take the floor. We examine whether these evolving expectations can be modeled through semantic uncertainty -- an LLM-derived measure of how strongly a turn so far constrains what may plausibly come next. To do so, we sample possible continuations of an ongoing turn and use changes in semantic dispersion to identify TRPs within turns. We evaluate this account on a dataset with TRP labels derived from real-time listener responses, rather than retrospective annotation. Our approach substantially outperforms prompt-based and fine-tuned text-only baselines, providing empirical support for the view that evolving semantic constraints inform perceived turn-taking opportunities in unscripted interaction.

articles.titleCn: 利用语义不确定性来估计轮流转换的相关性
articles.abstractCn: 轮流发言是一种基本机制，它决定了对话者何时说话和倾听。尽管对话系统（SDS）利用了多种语言、声学和肢体语言线索，但在非脚本化交互中，它们仍会产生时机不当的回应。一个核心挑战在于预测转换相关性位置（TRP），即听众发言的机会而非义务。人类听众不会等待发言结束；随着话语展开，他们利用对正在发展中的意义的预期来预测TRP，并决定是否发言。我们考察了这些不断发展的预期是否可以通过语义不确定性来建模——这是一种由大型语言模型（LLM）得出的衡量标准，用于评估当前发言如何约束接下来可能出现的合理内容的强度。为此，我们采样当前发言的可能延续，并利用语义分散的变化来识别发言中的TRP。我们在一个具有实时听众回应推导出的TRP标签的数据集上评估了这一方法，而非回顾性标注。我们的方法显著优于基于提示和仅微调文本的基线模型，为“不断发展的语义约束在非脚本化交互中影响感知的轮流发言机会”的观点提供了实证支持。

articles.title: Structurally Speaking: Motif-Oriented Graph Captioning through Bidirectional Graph-Text Translation
articles.abstract: Graph captions should help readers understand graph structure, rather than simply translate adjacency matrices into long textual edge lists. A useful graph caption abstracts connectivity into recognizable motifs, such as hubs, paths, cycles, cliques, and bridges, because these motifs provide compact structural units that are easier to read, compare, and recover. In this paper, we study motif-oriented graph captioning as a bidirectional graph-text translation task, where captions must both preserve enough topology for graph recovery and express the graph through concise motif-level descriptions. We show that direct prompting of GPT-5.1 often produces graph-recoverable captions by enumerating node-to-node connections, but these captions are verbose and can contain inconsistent motif interpretations. To address this gap, we introduce Structurally Speaking, a lightweight structured prompting protocol that guides translation between explicit connectivity and motif-level abstraction. Experiments on a synthetic motif-based dataset show that structured prompting produces shorter and more motif-consistent captions while maintaining comparable graph recovery. These results suggest that explicit topology-to-motif reasoning guidance can make LLM-generated graph captions more interpretable without model fine-tuning.
articles.titleCn: 从结构上讲：基于双向图文翻译的面向模式的图描述
articles.abstractCn: 图例应该帮助读者理解图结构，而不是仅仅将邻接矩阵翻译成冗长的文本边列表。一个有用的图例会将连通性抽象成可识别的模因，例如枢纽、路径、环、团和桥，因为这些模因提供了紧凑的结构单元，更易于阅读、比较和恢复。在本文中，我们研究以模因为导向的图例生成，将其视为一个双向图-文翻译任务，其中图例必须既保留足够的拓扑信息以实现图恢复，又通过简洁的模因级描述来表达图。我们证明，直接提示GPT-5.1通常通过列举节点间的连接来生成可恢复的图例，但这些图例冗长且可能包含不一致的模因解释。为解决这一差距，我们引入了结构化语言，一种轻量级结构化提示协议，它指导从显式连通性到模因级抽象的翻译。在合成模因数据集上的实验表明，结构化提示生成了更短且模因一致性更高的图例，同时保持了相当的图恢复能力。这些结果表明，显式拓扑到模因的推理指导可以使LLM生成的图例更具可解释性，而无需模型微调。

articles.title: Auto-RecSys: Harnessing Autonomous Research Agents for Industry-Scale Recommender System
articles.abstract: Auto-research agents have shown the potential to automate hypothesis generation, experiment execution, and iterative refinement. However, scaling this paradigm to industry-scale recommendation models introduces two challenges: (1) long feedback loops, where model training can take days, making serial iteration prohibitively slow and requiring parallel exploration across multiple research directions; and (2) system complexity, where large configurations, fragile infrastructure dependencies, and multi-day GPU jobs require robust and recoverable execution. We present Auto-RecSys, an autonomous research system for long-horizon experimentation on industry-scale recommendation models. Auto-RecSys addresses these challenges through three harness designs: (1) distributed asynchronous execution for running multiple experiments in parallel across servers, (2) centralized cross-server memory for persistent and recoverable execution across sessions and failures, and (3) cognitive-procedural separation, where natural-language skill files guide LLM reasoning while deterministic scripts enforce operational correctness. Auto-RecSys further employs a dual-loop self-evolving architecture: an Execution Evolution Loop in which model-specific playbooks accumulate operational knowledge by recording failed attempts and crystallizing successful pipelines, and an Idea Evolution Loop in which experimental outcomes inform subsequent ideation. Evaluated on recommendation models, Auto-RecSys significantly reduces the human time required per experiment cycle and improves execution reliability as its playbooks mature.
articles.titleCn: Auto-RecSys：利用自主研究代理构建工业级推荐系统
articles.abstractCn: 自动研究代理已展现出自动化假设生成、实验执行和迭代优化的潜力。然而，将这一范式扩展到工业级推荐模型时，会面临两大挑战：(1) 长反馈循环，模型训练可能需要数天，导致串行迭代速度过慢，需要跨多个研究方向并行探索；(2) 系统复杂性，大量配置、脆弱的基础设施依赖和多日GPU任务要求具有鲁棒性和可恢复性的执行。我们提出了Auto-RecSys，一个用于工业级推荐模型长周期实验的自主研究系统。Auto-RecSys通过三种 harness 设计解决这些挑战：(1) 分布式异步执行，可在多台服务器上并行运行多个实验；(2) 集中式跨服务器内存，实现跨会话和故障的持久化和可恢复执行；(3) 认知-过程分离，自然语言技能文件指导LLM推理，确定性脚本确保操作正确性。Auto-RecSys进一步采用双环自进化架构：一个执行进化环，其中特定模型的剧本通过记录失败尝试和固化成功流程来积累操作知识；一个想法进化环，其中实验结果指导后续构思。在推荐模型上的评估显示，Auto-RecSys显著减少了每个实验周期所需的人力时间，并随着其剧本的成熟提高了执行可靠性。
